batchnorm_mode: eval during training (running statistics frozen at ImageNet values)
predictors: image pixels only (224x224 resize, ImageNet normalization, train-only horizontal flip)
optimizer: Adam on fc parameters only (default betas, no weight decay)
selection_rule: highest validation accuracy; ties go to the earlier epoch, then to the lower learning rate
train_metrics: averaged over each epoch on augmented batches while training
val_metrics: full validation pass after each epoch, eval mode, no augmentation
deviations_from_MI2: Learning rates 0.001 and 0.0003 compared. MI2 Figure 3 lists 0.003 but the MI2 Methodology text lists 0.0003; the Methodology value is used.
Final split sizes are 265 train / 83 validation / 119 test after quality review (MI2 listed 272/90/120 before review). The 80% goal requires 96 of 119 correct.
Backbone BatchNorm layers are kept in eval mode during training so their running statistics stay at the ImageNet values; this clarifies "frozen backbone".
